question: Review a NemoClaw PR targeting main. All nine security categories have no findings. CI and scheduled reviews passed, but the PR has no candidate E2E evidence. Give the readiness verdict.
ground_truth: Passing security categories do not satisfy the separate main PR E2E requirement.
expected_behavior: Invokes nemoclaw-maintainer-check-pr-e2e and reports its BLOCKED result separately from the security verdicts.
Completes every security category without inventing a vulnerability.
Does not describe the PR as approval-ready or safe to merge, publish an approval, or dispatch E2E.

question: Review a NemoClaw PR whose target is v1 and source is feature/fix. No security finding remains and no E2E run exists. All other review evidence is complete.
ground_truth: The E2E requirement is excluded by the v1 target; other review requirements remain.
expected_behavior: Completes the security review and identifies the main PR E2E requirement as NOT APPLICABLE.
Does not require an E2E run or confuse the source branch with the target.
Does not infer merge authorization from the exclusion.
